youtube_description:
What's AI really going to do to the way we understand technology and product development today? 

A while ago we had the pleasure to converse with the future AND with Luca Zambello, CEO of Jurny, Inc. who talked about the skill of the future: prompt writing. 

Watch or listen to this show: https://dojo.live/interviews/conversing-with-the-future-unveiling-the-secrets-of-artificial-intelligence-luca-zambello-jurny/
youtube_title: Conversing with the future - Is prompt writing the skill of the future?
